name: Logan Inn
notes: Long-standing dive bar in Barrio Logan: jukebox, pool table, drinks only. Consistent across Yelp, MapQuest, restaurantji, fourdollarjacks ('Bars Near Me' category) and RestaurantGuru's own menu page (0 priced items found on https://restaurantguru.com/Logan-Inn-San-Diego/menu). No food service found anywhere; no per-item prices published.
blocked: dive bar, no food menu found (Yelp/MapQuest only); hold candidate, not closed

name: ABC Market & Deli
blocked: Food counter inside this market operates as 'The Girls Deli' (same address, 3075 El Cajon Blvd). Its Wix menu widget serves unedited demo template content (Tuna sashimi, Peanut crusted steak, Schnitzel, Bread & dips) rather than the real sandwich menu - no genuine priced items found. The batch's Uber Eats link (order.ubereats.com/...) redirects to a bot-detection challenge page (def.uber.com/en/challenge), not the menu. No other ordering platform found.

name: Hillside Ranch Vineyard
notes: Boutique winery/tasting room, not a food business. Own site (checked every page: home, gallery, faq, blog, vineyards, about, club, visit-us) publishes only a flat $20 tasting fee ('five pours') and no food menu, no per-bottle wine list, no snack menu anywhere.
blocked: winery, no food menu found; hold candidate, not closed

name: Bodega Market
notes: Own site (bodegamarket.com) has no prices; Seamless/Grubhub listing is client-rendered with no static prices. DoorDash React Query state (MenuBookCategory counts: Matcha 1, Sandwiches 3, Tea 1, Coffee Drinks 7 = 12 real items) confirms the 'Most Ordered' carousel (9 items) is entirely a duplicate sample of those 12 - deduped on name+price to the true 12-item menu. All prices end in conventional .00/.50/.99, no markup pattern detected.

No other priced source found (Campo, CA is a small rural community with minimal web presence for this business).

name: Super Express Chinese Food
blocked: No priced menu source found anywhere. cafes-guide.com (barred farm domain) itself shows 'Oops! Our menu is under update'. No DoorDash/Uber Eats/Grubhub storefront found via search. The batch's listed 'website' is a broken lovable.app dev-preview link (id-preview--...lovable.app), not a real business site. Yelp's menu tab is barred by policy. Yahoo Local page has no real menu data (only Next.js framework noise and an unrelated photo caption fragment).

name: The coffee machine
blocked: Brand-new second location ('The Coffee Machine II'), grand opening late Dec 2025 per its own Instagram; own ordering page on joe.coffee is fully client-rendered (React app shell, 0 static prices, no embedded JSON menu data). Instagram/Facebook/chulavistaliving.com articles confirm the shop exists but publish no prices ('menu details are limited online'). No DoorDash/Uber Eats/Grubhub/Toast storefront found.

name: Crazy wings•n•fries
notes: Own Toast ordering site's server-rendered __OO_STATE__ React state gives the full Daily Menu + Breakfast Menu catalog (73 items across Crazy Favorites, Wings, Tenders, Sandwiches, Salads, Personal Combos, Family Packs, Sides & Appetizers, Dips, Sauces, Sweets, Drinks, Specials, and breakfast Burritos/Chilaquiles) - one item with no listed price was dropped. Uber Eats/Postmates listings for the same restaurant show higher marked-up prices (e.g. 10 Pc Wings $23.99 vs $19.99 here) - the direct Toast site is used as the non-marked-up source.
